item.text: The sources show two execution paths: persistent Codex chat turns and Pi diagram generation with validated submissions. I’m tracing how child canvases stay isolated and how edits are applied so the tree makes those boundaries clear.

item.text:
{"ascii":"Agent Chat and Generation
|-- Persistent conversations: AgentChatPanel -> AgentChatService
|   |-- Panel: conversation tabs, drafts, selected references, model / effort / access
|   |   |-- Send / Read Canvas / Stop / Resume / Reload tools
|   |   `-- EventSource -> ChatStream -> transcript, activity and pending questions
|   |-- ChatStore retains sessions, native thread IDs, items, settings and request IDs
|   |   |-- New chat -> thread/start with chat instructions and tool definitions
|   |   `-- Import native thread -> thread/resume with its saved instructions and history
|   |       `-- Reject an already-active thread; imported chat initially has no canvas tools
|   |-- Start one turn per conversation
|   |   |-- Capture canvas target and selected reference snapshots
|   |   |-- Read Canvas -> deliver short canvas context as read_canvas tool output
|   |   `-- Persist request ID before turn/start -> repeated request cannot start twice
|   |-- Execution adapter: StdioCodexConnection
|   |   |-- Spawn codex app-server --listen stdio:// -> initialize handshake
|   |   |-- Line-delimited JSON RPC; request IDs correlate responses; 30-second timeout
|   |   `-- Native events -> AgentChatService.receive
|   |       |-- Items, plans, usage and buffered text deltas -> session updates
|   |       |-- Tool calls -> bound tool dispatch below
|   |       |-- Questions / approvals -> panel -> answer -> native response
|   |       `-- Turn completion -> idle / interrupted / failed; persist and settle generation
|   `-- Recovery
|       |-- Connection loss -> fail active chats, clear bindings and pending requests
|       `-- Server restart -> interrupt unfinished items and chats; fail unfinished generations
|-- Bound canvas tools: native calls or MappingChatMcpBinding -> shared dispatch
|   |-- MCP token identifies chat; binding carries canvas target and read-only flag
|   |   |-- Require active conversation and a registered tool definition
|   |   `-- Reload while idle -> refresh MCP catalog while retaining thread history
|   |-- gen-alternatives -> AgentChatService child-generation workflow below
|   `-- Other tools -> ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|       |-- edit-diagram / create-diagram / extend-diagram
|       |   |-- Require write access; resolve selected reference or explicit node ID
|       |   |-- All operations target one document and one captured canvas snapshot
|       |   |-- Check current base revision and complete subtree selections
|       |   `-- submitDirect -> shared batch / revision workflow below
|       |       `-- Status and cancellation are restricted to the owning conversation
|       |-- Context tools -> saved AgentContext or diagram-owned source context
|       |-- Canvas tools -> views, projections and requested highlights
|       `-- Mutation retries reuse prepared arguments
|           `-- Same request ID with changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|-- Independent canvas alternatives: AgentChatService.genAlternatives
|   |-- Preconditions: writable parent chat, prior user message, source canvas and tools
|   |   `-- Child generations cannot launch nested generations
|   |-- Capture input -> allocate run, candidate view IDs and child chat IDs
|   |   |-- Save child records and parent request receipt
|   |   |-- canvas-generation start checks source version and returns captured history
|   |   `-- Retain input history, prompts, settings and optional AgentContext ID / hash
|   |-- Schedule candidates together; each owns one managed turn
|   |   |-- With saved AgentContext -> new thread + inject captured reference material
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> fork parent at captured turn boundary
|   |   |-- Clear inherited goal; retain model, effort and tool definitions
|   |   `-- Give each child a distinct thread, MCP binding and isolated controller
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge: normal CanvasSessionPort command contract
|   |   |-- add -> MappingDocumentController built from captured history
|   |   |   `-- Parent and sibling controllers remain independent; browser selection unchanged
|   |   |-- Reads -> identity / context / document-state / read / snapshot
|   |   |-- Writes -> apply / revision / batch / create / diagram context / checkpoint
|   |   |   |-- Serialize commands per child; check document binding and versions
|   |   |   |-- Cache receipt by method + request ID; reject changed retry arguments
|   |   |   `-- Persist exported history before returning the mutation receipt
|   |   `-- Live targets delegate to live bridge; child fork management is unavailable
|   `-- Finish -> finished / cancelled / failed
|       |-- Retain final metadata and history in child chat
|       |-- Finished candidate -> save history into its candidate view on source canvas
|       |-- Save unavailable -> retain result and reconcile on later generation listing
|       |-- Always clear binding, remove isolated controller and unsubscribe child thread
|       `-- Chats remain reviewable; reruns reuse captured history through the same executor
`-- Shared diagram revision workflow
    |-- DiagramBatchService: direct submissions or generated operations
    |   |-- Capture one versioned snapshot for the whole batch
    |   |-- Reject multiple edits to the same shared diagram
    |   |-- Run DiagramEditService operations sequentially against that snapshot
    |   |   `-- Collect validated edits and creations without applying each to live canvas
    |   `-- Submit one combined batch -> receipt supplies version and unresolved edge IDs
    |-- DiagramEditService: one request owns generation and installation
    |   |-- Validate operation, template, context source, target version and base revision
    |   |-- Resolve exact retained revisions for target and prompt references
    |   |   |-- Whole-diagram reference -> pinned ASCII
    |   |   |-- Node reference -> pinned excerpt, range and node identities
    |   |   `-- Context -> supplied snapshot or matching diagram-owned source context
    |   |-- Produce candidate
    |   |   |-- Supplied ASCII -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
    |   |   `-- Generated ASCII -> DiagramGenerator.generate(request, options)
    |   |       |-- Request: template/options, pinned references, evidence, scope and node IDs
    |   |       `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime extends PiAgentRuntime
    |   |           |-- Separate execution adapter from the Codex stdio chat connection
    |   |           |-- Authenticated model + persisted Pi session; import resolved context
    |   |           |-- Render captured edit prompt; expose submit_diagram_edit
    |   |           |-- createValidatedSubmission
    |   |           |   |-- Rejected -> return correction details; agent can submit again
    |   |           |   `-- Accepted -> retain candidate and terminate submission loop
    |   |           |-- No validated submission -> fail generation
    |   |           `-- Return validated result / captured context; dispose session on exit
    |   `-- Install result
    |       |-- In-place edit -> apply revision with document and base-revision checks
    |       |-- Variant -> store review revisions and optional presentation alternative
    |       `-- Create / extend -> place new diagrams; extend also validates source anchors
    |           `-- Placement rereads current version; retry version conflict up to 3 attempts
    |-- Generated edit validation: validateGeneratedDiagramEdit
    |   |-- Parse ASCII, structure kind, optional replacement ranges and source mappings
    |   |-- Enforce mapping mode; strip continuity markers into node correspondence
    |   |-- Build and validate content; require each marker to identify one output node
    |   `-- Scoped Pi edits also preserve structure kind and validate replacement boundaries
    `-- Application outcome and retry contract
        |-- Acknowledged application -> completed with document version / revision results
        |-- Version mismatch -> conflict; other errors -> failed
        |-- Timeout, unavailable canvas or pending persistence during apply
        |   `-- awaiting-acknowledgement -> identical retry reapplies retained result
        |       `-- Model generation is not repeated
        `-- Cancellation applies while generating; dispatched application is not called cancelled"}
